footer.tagline: Our motto is: Look beyond the window. Create with authenticity. Make an impact with purpose.
home.hero.headline: We build brands with purpose, strategy, and essence.
home.hero.sub: Ikigai is a branding and content agency that turns the essence of brands into strategic positioning.
home.intro.title: Every brand has a purpose. Ours is to reveal it to the world.
home.intro.text1: We believe a brand isn't built only by what it posts, but by everything it communicates, delivers, and makes people feel.
home.intro.text2: That's why we bring branding, strategy, content, and storytelling together — creating brands that stay true to themselves, from essence to experience.
home.intro.text3: Every project here starts with the same question: what purpose needs to take shape?
home.audience.title: For brands that know they have something special, but need to communicate it with clarity.
home.audience.text1: We work with entrepreneurs, personal brands, service-based businesses, and companies that want to grow without losing their essence.
home.audience.text2: Brands that don't just want to be seen — they want to build meaning, recognition, and connection.
home.audience.1.title: For those just starting out
home.audience.1.text: Who need to build a brand with direction from day one.
home.audience.2.title: For those growing
home.audience.2.text: Who notice their communication no longer matches the size of their business.
home.audience.3.title: For those repositioning
home.audience.3.text: Who need to realign essence, strategy, and expression for a new phase.
home.services.title: Main Services
home.services.1.desc: We manage your brand's entire communication—from planning to publication—building consistent positioning, strong presence, and sustainable growth.
home.services.2.desc: We combine copywriting, design, editing, and video production to deliver strategic, ready-to-publish content for your brand.
home.services.3.desc: We turn events, product launches, brand trips, and live experiences into strategic narratives—produced and published in real time.
home.services.4.name: Profile Analysis
home.services.4.desc: A strategic session to uncover gaps, unlock opportunities, and map out the next steps to strengthen your digital presence.
home.services.5.desc: We map your core essence, purpose, differentiators, and strategic positioning to build a clear direction before you communicate, scale, or reposition.
home.services.6.desc: We build brands from the ground up, seamlessly combining strategy, naming, and visual identity to create a strong presence with purpose and personality.
home.services.7.desc: Websites, catalogs, sales presentations, e-books, and campaign materials for launches or events—tailored to your brand's needs.
home.method.title: The Ikigai Method
home.method.intro1: We don't start with a post. We start with the brand.
home.method.intro2: Our process turns what makes a business unique into communication that's strategic, recognizable, and consistent.
home.method.1.title: Essence
home.method.1.text: We dig into purpose, history, values, audience — everything that grounds the brand.
home.method.2.title: Strategy
home.method.2.text: We define positioning, message, goals, and the path that guides communication.
home.method.3.title: Expression
home.method.3.text: We turn strategy into identity, content, language, and presence.
home.method.4.title: Experience
home.method.4.text: We build touchpoints that make the brand seen, remembered, and felt.

about.hero.headline: More than a marketing agency, we build authentic narratives.
about.hero.photoAlt: Julia and Luiz holding hands beneath a red Japanese temple gate in Tokyo
about.hero.sub: We craft strategies that capture each brand's unique essence—elevating its presence with sophistication, creativity, and meaningful connections.
about.essence.title: Our essence
about.essence.text1: Ikigai is a Japanese concept representing what gives life meaning—the reason to wake up every morning. It was from this core idea that our agency was born.
about.essence.text2: We believe strong brands aren't built just to sell. They stem from a true intention, a compelling story, and something genuinely worth sharing. That's why our mission is to ignite the purpose within every brand we partner with.
about.essence.text3: We dive deep into your story, understand your vision, and translate what makes you unique into a clear, authentic, and impactful strategy.
about.essence.text4: Because when a brand embraces its essence, it stops merely communicating—and starts claiming its rightful place in the world.
about.founders.title: Who's behind Ikigai
about.founders.1.photoAlt: Julia Rocha, founder and creative director of Ikigai, in a lantern-lit alley in Japan
about.founders.1.bio1: Ju is the creative and strategic mind behind Ikigai.
about.founders.1.bio2: Driven by a passion for branding, storytelling, and the transformative power of a strong narrative, she remains actively involved in every project—leading strategy, positioning, and the agency's creative direction.
about.founders.1.bio3: Her journey between Brazil and Japan shaped a rich perspective on culture, consumer behavior, experience, and communication. These influences now define Ikigai's essence and the meticulous care behind every brand created.
about.founders.1.bio4: Julia believes branding is in everything: the message, the aesthetics, the overall experience, the subtle details—and above all, how a brand makes people feel.
about.founders.1.bio5: Her work is dedicated to helping businesses and entrepreneurs gain clarity on who they are, translating that core essence into an authentic, strategic, and memorable presence.
about.founders.2.photoAlt: Luiz Eduardo Umeda, co-founder and director of operations of Ikigai, in a lantern-lit alley in Japan
about.founders.2.bio1: Luiz is responsible for turning vision into structure.
about.founders.2.bio2: Heading Ikigai's finance, operations, and administration, he organizes the processes that allow every project to run with clarity, consistency, and excellence.
about.founders.2.bio3: His analytical and strategic mindset complements the agency's creative direction—bridging strategy, feasibility, and execution.
about.founders.2.bio4: Alongside Julia, Luiz plays a key role in building and growing Ikigai, ensuring the client experience is backed by a seamless, dedicated, and reliable operation.
about.founders.together: Together, Julia and Luiz combine creativity and structure, sensitivity and strategy, purpose and execution.
about.abroad.title: Our team abroad
about.abroad.intro: Our international presence allows us to work closely with brands and projects across the United States, Italy, and Japan, seamlessly combining strategy, key relationships, and local content production.
about.abroad.1.photoAlt: Ana Lima, Ikigai's sales representative in the United States, in Chicago
about.abroad.1.bio1: Ana represents Ikigai in the North American market, building connections with brands, entrepreneurs, and companies looking to strengthen their communication and positioning.
about.abroad.1.bio2: She handles the first business contacts, presents the agency's services, and helps discover how Ikigai can drive value for each brand.
about.abroad.2.photoAlt: João Pedro, Ikigai's videomaker in the United States, in Times Square, New York
about.abroad.2.bio1: João Pedro is responsible for bringing strategies and creative concepts to life through visuals.
about.abroad.2.bio2: With a keen eye for movement, atmosphere, and detail, he leads audiovisual production for Ikigai's projects in the United States.
about.abroad.3.photoAlt: Beatriz, Ikigai's social media and videomaker in Italy, in Venice
about.abroad.3.bio1: Beatriz combines content strategy with audiovisual production.
about.abroad.3.bio2: As Social Media Manager and Videomaker, she plays a key role in building brand narratives, turning ideas into dynamic, creative content that deeply resonates with audiences.
about.abroad.3.bio3: Her local presence keeps her seamlessly connected to our clients' day-to-day routines, behind-the-scenes moments, and experiences in Italy—bringing both authenticity and agility to production.
about.perspectives.title: One Team, Different Perspectives
about.perspectives.text1: Every professional at Ikigai brings a unique perspective. Strategy, branding, creative direction, social media, audiovisual production, business relations, and operations come together so every project is built in a complete, coherent way.
about.perspectives.text2: We don't believe in one-size-fits-all solutions. We believe in listening, depth, and genuine connection. That's why we work side by side with every client, honoring their story, their journey, and their goals.
about.closing.title: Authentic Brands Start From Within
about.closing.text1: Before considering how a brand will be perceived, we seek to understand who it truly is.
about.closing.text2: That core essence is where every strategy, story, piece of content, and experience we design originates. Because while aesthetics may catch someone's attention, it is the truth behind the brand that makes them stay.
about.closing.mantra: Our purpose is to ignite yours.

services.choose.text1: You don't need to have it all figured out before reaching out to us.
services.choose.text2: In our initial discovery call, we take time to understand your brand's current stage, challenges, and goals so we can guide you toward the most effective solution.
